$comment: The Idempotency-Key the GPT-Video API accepts, and the keys each generator in this repository makes. Every SDK checks a key the caller passes against `accepted` before it sends anything, and refuses every entry of `invalid` with the same check. Every generator makes keys that match both `accepted` and its own pattern. Match the whole string: in Python use re.fullmatch, because `$` also matches before a final newline.

accepted.rule: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, with no spaces.

valid.why: a comma is a visible character
quotes and backslashes are visible characters
a UUID, the form the SDKs make
the form the n8n node makes

invalid.why: 256 characters, one more than the longest key
a space: two Idempotency-Key headers arrive joined by a comma and a space
a final newline, which a Python `$` would let through
a line break, which would split the header

js.how: crypto.randomUUID(), once per call, before the first attempt

python.how: str(uuid.uuid4()), once per call, before the first attempt

postman.how: pm- and the SHA-256, in lowercase hex, of the method, the resolved path after the API version (no host, no query), the resolved body in canonical form and the per-person salt

n8n.how: n8n- and the SHA-256, in lowercase hex, of the instance, workflow, execution, node, run, item and call, once per call of an item; when an AI Agent runs the node as a tool, the arguments of the tool call take the place of the run; a key the user sets in the node is sent as it is, or followed by : and the name of the call when one item makes several calls
